adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from requiring `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the example named "is false if embeddable_host is blank" no longer sets `embed_truncate` true or stubs `has_topic_embed?`, so it will be false regardless of host presence (because defaults/unstubbed conditions make it false). Also, the "with an emeddable host" block fabricates an `EmbeddableHost` row even though the new method no longer reads it, meaning a regression that reintroduces a host-presence gate could still pass when that block runs. This is a real, diff-grounded test coverage/misdocumentation issue, but not a directly verifiable production defect from the diff alone.
